Last year, we introduced Microsoft Sovereign Cloud to give customers more choice in how they address these requirements.
Oct 20, 2026 | Douglas Phillips - President and Chief Technology Officer, Microsoft Specialized Clouds Across my conversations with leaders in government, critical infrastructure and regulated industries, one priority consistently rises to the top: putting technology to work on their most important systems while maintaining the control those systems require.
Digital sovereignty should give organizations greater control and security over the technology they depend on, while continuing to innovate.

Microsoft.title: Securing the agentic insider - The Official Microsoft Blog
Microsoft.titleEn: Securing the agentic insider - The Official Microsoft Blog
Microsoft.titleKo: 에이전트 내부자 보호 - 공식 Microsoft 블로그
Microsoft.summary:
Project Perception can be leveraged to contain agentic insiders, implementing deterministic controls on non-deterministic intelligence: Sensors/Signals/Actuators: bring together signals across the various sensors (identity, data, cloud, endpoint, network, runtime) to discover agents in the enterprise and bring them under management by assigning an identity, container and set of policy and permissions .
In July, we announced Project Perception , an agentic security system that uses our new cyber stack and teams of red, blue and green agents to help defenders act with speed, while defending against AI driven attacks from outside of the enterprise.
Project Perception can supervise in real time while providing traceability for practitioners to examine what happened, understand why the risk emerged and apply the judgment needed to update their security system accordingly.
summaryLinesEn: Project Perception can be leveraged to contain agentic insiders, implementing deterministic controls on non-deterministic intelligence: Sensors/Signals/Actuators: bring together signals across the various sensors (identity, data, cloud, endpoint, network, runtime) to discover agents in the enterprise and bring them under management by assigning an identity, container and set of policy and permissions .

In July, we announced Project Perception , an agentic security system that uses our new cyber stack and teams of red, blue and green agents to help defenders act with speed, while defending against AI driven attacks from outside of the enterprise.

Project Perception can supervise in real time while providing traceability for practitioners to examine what happened, understand why the risk emerged and apply the judgment needed to update their security system accordingly.
summaryLinesKo: Project Perception은 에이전트 내부자를 포함하고 비결정적 인텔리전스에 대한 결정론적 제어를 구현하는 데 활용될 수 있음 · 센서/신호/액추에이터 · 다양한 센서(ID, 데이터, 클라우드, 엔드포인트, 네트워크, 런타임)에 걸쳐 신호를 모아 기업 내 에이전트를 검색하고 ID, 컨테이너, 정책 및 권한 집합을 할당하여 이를 관리할 수 있음
7월에 우리는 새로운 사이버 스택과 레드, 블루, 그린 에이전트 팀을 사용하여 방어자가 신속하게 행동하는 동시에 기업 외부의 AI 기반 공격을 방어하는 에이전트 보안 시스템인 Project Perception을 발표함
Project Perception은 실무자가 무슨 일이 일어났는지 조사하고, 위험이 발생한 이유를 이해하고, 이에 따라 보안 시스템을 업데이트하는 데 필요한 판단을 적용할 수 있도록 추적성을 제공하면서 실시간으로 감독할 수 있음

This shift reflects ongoing innovation across the technology ecosystem to give organizations greater flexibility in where they run AI and process sensitive data, and it is changing the digital sovereignty conversation.
Discover how Microsoft Sovereign Cloud in Europe helps organizations address evolving data sovereignty, security, and compliance requirements while accelerating cloud and AI innovation.
Designing for sovereign AI: A shared foundation from edge to cloud As organizations apply AI to more business-critical and data-intensive workloads, AI processing is moving closer to where data is created, decisions are made, and operations take place.

NVIDIA.summary:
With Palantir , NVIDIA’s supply chain organization is using Agent Knowledge Foundation through Palantir Foundry, Ontology and AIP to deploy specialized agents, create actionable intelligence from proprietary data, predict outcomes and optimize decision-making.

NVIDIA.summary:
These new controls let frontier model builders use bare-metal instances to own and operate their bespoke software stack, including host and platform infrastructure software, when operating on NVIDIA accelerated computing infrastructure across third-party cloud, neocloud and enterprise infrastructure.
Today, NVIDIA is expanding that layer with Confidential Bare Metal, a new deployment option with NVIDIA Confidential Computing that enables frontier model builders to run sensitive workloads on dedicated third-party infrastructure while retaining control of their models and data.

NVIDIA.titleKo: 엔비디아 cuDSS, 이제 엔지니어링 및 과학 시뮬레이션 가속화를 위해 정식 출시
NVIDIA.summary:
Industry leaders are already integrating NVIDIA cuDSS into their tools to transform workflows for their end customers: Applied Materials: With cuDSS, Applied Materials accelerated sparse solves in Ginestra, its physics-based, defect-centric simulation platform, by up to 10x versus CPU-only approaches, speeding exploration of semiconductor materials and device reliability.

NVIDIA.title: Europe’s Industrial Leaders Reinvent Engineering and Manufacturing With NVIDIA
NVIDIA.titleEn: Europe’s Industrial Leaders Reinvent Engineering and Manufacturing With NVIDIA
NVIDIA.titleKo: 유럽의 산업 리더들은 NVIDIA를 통해 엔지니어링 및 제조를 재창조함
NVIDIA.summary:
To increase productivity, accelerate innovation and create new opportunities for economic growth, Europe’s industrial leaders are tapping NVIDIA CUDA-X and Omniverse libraries , as well as NVIDIA Cosmos and Nemotron open models, across the engineering and manufacturing lifecycle.
At GTC Berlin, NVIDIA is releasing cuDSS for general availability , accelerating the demanding calculations behind the complex simulations of structural stress, fluid flow, electromagnetic fields and semiconductor device behavior.
Siemens is integrating agents built using FOX into Intelligence Center X, its agentic enterprise system, to help identify root causes and coordinate factory operations, for estimated cost savings of 20%.
summaryLinesEn: To increase productivity, accelerate innovation and create new opportunities for economic growth, Europe’s industrial leaders are tapping NVIDIA CUDA-X and Omniverse libraries , as well as NVIDIA Cosmos and Nemotron open models, across the engineering and manufacturing lifecycle.

At GTC Berlin, NVIDIA is releasing cuDSS for general availability , accelerating the demanding calculations behind the complex simulations of structural stress, fluid flow, electromagnetic fields and semiconductor device behavior.

Siemens is integrating agents built using FOX into Intelligence Center X, its agentic enterprise system, to help identify root causes and coordinate factory operations, for estimated cost savings of 20%.
summaryLinesKo: 생산성을 높이고 혁신을 가속화하며 경제 성장을 위한 새로운 기회를 창출하기 위해 유럽의 산업 리더들은 엔지니어링 및 제조 라이프사이클 전반에 걸쳐 NVIDIA CUDA-X 및 Omniverse 라이브러리는 물론 NVIDIA Cosmos 및 Nemotron 개방형 모델을 활용하고 있음
GTC 베를린에서 NVIDIA는 구조적 응력, 유체 흐름, 전자기장 및 반도체 장치 동작의 복잡한 시뮬레이션 뒤에 있는 까다로운 계산을 가속화하는 cuDSS를 일반 출시용으로 출시함
Siemens는 근본 원인을 식별하고 공장 운영을 조정하기 위해 FOX를 사용하여 구축된 에이전트를 에이전트 엔터프라이즈 시스템인 Intelligence Center X에 통합하여 예상 비용을 20% 절감하고 있음

NVIDIA.summary:
NVIDIA Cloud Partners across Europe, the Nordics, Africa, and Central Asia are expanding regional compute capacity for model training and inference, helping developers build agentic and physical AI applications, and establishing boundaries around what agents can access and do.

NVIDIA.title: Google Cloud and NVIDIA Announce General Availability of NVIDIA Vera Rubin Infrastructure
NVIDIA.titleEn: Google Cloud and NVIDIA Announce General Availability of NVIDIA Vera Rubin Infrastructure
NVIDIA.titleKo: Google Cloud와 NVIDIA, NVIDIA Vera Rubin 인프라 정식 출시 발표
NVIDIA.summary:
To support energy-efficient deployment at scale, Google Cloud and NVIDIA are exploring NVIDIA DSX MaxLPS capabilities for Vera Rubin-based infrastructure to help optimize performance per watt and expand capacity within available data-center power budgets.
A5X brings Vera Rubin into Google Cloud’s AI Hypercomputer as an integrated system, combining compute, networking and storage to support experience-driven learning at scale.
Google Cloud plans to scale its Vera Rubin-based infrastructure to as many as 960,000 Rubin GPUs across multiple sites.

Google Cloud plans to scale its Vera Rubin-based infrastructure to as many as 960,000 Rubin GPUs across multiple sites.

A5X는 Vera Rubin을 Google Cloud의 AI 하이퍼컴퓨터에 통합 시스템으로 도입하여 컴퓨팅, 네트워킹, 스토리지를 결합하여 규모에 맞는 경험 중심 학습을 지원함
Google Cloud는 Vera Rubin 기반 인프라를 여러 사이트에 걸쳐 최대 960,000개의 Rubin GPU로 확장할 계획임

NVIDIA.summary:
For larger teams, DGX Station offers 748GB of coherent memory and up to 20 petaflops of AI performance, enabling developers to run advanced models like GLM 5.3 and serve 30+ users at speeds comparable to those provided by cloud models.
RTX Spark is a new beginning for the PC — running personal agents, accelerated content creation and 1440p 100 frames-per-second gaming with up to 128GB of unified memory and 1 petaflop of AI compute.
RTX Spark , which launched last week , powers personal agents on Windows PCs; DGX Spark supports developers building and scaling applications on Linux; and DGX Station serves enterprise teams running frontier workloads on Linux, with a Windows version arriving in December.

Apple.title: AnyLanguageModel 1.0: One Year of Local Models on Apple Platforms
Apple.titleEn: AnyLanguageModel 1.0: One Year of Local Models on Apple Platforms
Apple.summary:
Last November, we introduced AnyLanguageModel on this blog: a drop-in replacement for Apple's Foundation Models framework that lets you choose the model and provider your app uses.
Support for hosted models expanded this year, too.
A year and dozens of releases later, AnyLanguageModel 1.0 is out, along with swift-huggingface 1.0 and swift-xet 1.0 .

Today marks a milestone for MacPaw, as the company is releasing Eney, a proactive AI assistant that works across your apps, files, and system to help you get things done, following a development process that began back in 2019.
A few days ago, I had the opportunity to talk to Oleksandr Kosovan, founder and CEO of MacPaw, as he showed me Eney , the company’s Mac-first proactive AI assistant.

Google DeepMind.titleEn: Now you can chat with Gemini while using Google Maps through CarPlay - Engadget
Google DeepMind.titleKo: 이제 CarPlay - Engadget을 통해 Google 지도를 사용하면서 Gemini와 채팅할 수 있음
Google DeepMind.summary:
If you're one of the many CarPlay users who prefers Google Maps for navigation, Google has begun rolling out a small but meaningful update for the iOS version of Maps.
Now you can use the company's conversational driving experience, Gemini in navigation, through CarPlay.
The update arrives after Google yesterday announced it was beginning to roll out Gemini Personal Intelligence to Android Auto users .

Google DeepMind.title: Google Cloud now offers OpenAI models alongside Gemini and Claude, becoming the only major provider with all three
Google DeepMind.titleEn: Google Cloud now offers OpenAI models alongside Gemini and Claude, becoming the only major provider with all three
Google DeepMind.titleKo: Google Cloud는 이제 Gemini 및 Claude와 함께 OpenAI 모델을 제공하여 이 세 가지 모델을 모두 갖춘 유일한 주요 제공업체가 됨
Google DeepMind.summary:
The move highlights a recurring tension at Google: compute capacity spent serving cloud customers strengthens the biggest rivals of its own Gemini team.
Three OpenAI models are available starting today : GPT-6 Astra for demanding tasks like coding and research, GPT-6.1 Sol as a cheaper alternative with similar performance, and GPT-6 Luna as a fast, cost-efficient option for everyday use.
Google Cloud is now the only major cloud provider offering Gemini, Claude, and OpenAI models on one platform.
summaryLinesEn: The move highlights a recurring tension at Google: compute capacity spent serving cloud customers strengthens the biggest rivals of its own Gemini team.

Three OpenAI models are available starting today : GPT-6 Astra for demanding tasks like coding and research, GPT-6.1 Sol as a cheaper alternative with similar performance, and GPT-6 Luna as a fast, cost-efficient option for everyday use.
Google Cloud is now the only major cloud provider offering Gemini, Claude, and OpenAI models on one platform.
summaryLinesKo: 이러한 움직임은 Google에서 반복되는 긴장감을 강조함 · 클라우드 고객에게 서비스를 제공하는 데 사용되는 컴퓨팅 용량은 자체 Gemini 팀의 가장 큰 경쟁자를 강화함
오늘부터 세 가지 OpenAI 모델을 사용할 수 있음 · 코딩 및 연구와 같은 까다로운 작업을 위한 GPT-6 Astra, 유사한 성능을 갖춘 저렴한 대안인 GPT-6.1 Sol, 일상적인 사용을 위한 빠르고 비용 효율적인 옵션인 GPT-6 Luna임
Google Cloud는 이제 단일 플랫폼에서 Gemini, Claude, OpenAI 모델을 제공하는 유일한 주요 클라우드 제공업체임

Google DeepMind.title: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol and Google's Gemini 4 Argon found critical PHP flaw affecting millions of websites
Google DeepMind.titleEn: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol and Google's Gemini 4 Argon found critical PHP flaw affecting millions of websites
Google DeepMind.titleKo: OpenAI의 GPT-5.6 Sol과 Google의 Gemini 4 Argon에서 수백만 개의 웹사이트에 영향을 미치는 심각한 PHP 결함을 발견함
Google DeepMind.summary:
GPT-5.6 Sol tracked down the flaw as part of the Patch-the-Planet initiative , which OpenAI calls one of the "most impactful security issues in recent memory."
The company expects findings on the scale of the PHP2Shell flaw to "increase sharply in the coming months," but warns that the same AI capabilities that find vulnerabilities can help attackers too.
Security firm Wiz found the same flaws independently, using its own Wiz Atlas platform alongside Google's Gemini 4 Argon and GPT-5.6 Sol.
summaryLinesEn: GPT-5.6 Sol tracked down the flaw as part of the Patch-the-Planet initiative , which OpenAI calls one of the "most impactful security issues in recent memory."
The company expects findings on the scale of the PHP2Shell flaw to "increase sharply in the coming months," but warns that the same AI capabilities that find vulnerabilities can help attackers too.
Security firm Wiz found the same flaws independently, using its own Wiz Atlas platform alongside Google's Gemini 4 Argon and GPT-5.6 Sol.
summaryLinesKo: GPT-5.6 Sol은 OpenAI가 "최근 메모리에서 가장 영향력 있는 보안 문제" 중 하나라고 부르는 Patch-the-Planet 이니셔티브의 일환으로 결함을 추적함
회사는 PHP2Shell 결함 규모에 대한 발견이 "앞으로 몇 달 안에 급격히 증가"할 것으로 예상하지만, 취약점을 찾는 동일한 AI 기능이 공격자에게도 도움이 될 수 있다고 경고함
보안 회사인 Wiz는 Google의 Gemini 4 Argon 및 GPT-5.6 Sol과 함께 자체 Wiz Atlas 플랫폼을 사용하여 동일한 결함을 독립적으로 발견함

Google DeepMind.title: Google Cloud and NVIDIA Announce General Availability of NVIDIA Vera Rubin Infrastructure
Google DeepMind.titleEn: Google Cloud and NVIDIA Announce General Availability of NVIDIA Vera Rubin Infrastructure
Google DeepMind.titleKo: Google Cloud와 NVIDIA, NVIDIA Vera Rubin 인프라 정식 출시 발표
Google DeepMind.summary:
To support energy-efficient deployment at scale, Google Cloud and NVIDIA are exploring NVIDIA DSX MaxLPS capabilities for Vera Rubin-based infrastructure to help optimize performance per watt and expand capacity within available data-center power budgets.
A5X brings Vera Rubin into Google Cloud’s AI Hypercomputer as an integrated system, combining compute, networking and storage to support experience-driven learning at scale.
Google Cloud plans to scale its Vera Rubin-based infrastructure to as many as 960,000 Rubin GPUs across multiple sites.
summaryLinesEn: To support energy-efficient deployment at scale, Google Cloud and NVIDIA are exploring NVIDIA DSX MaxLPS capabilities for Vera Rubin-based infrastructure to help optimize performance per watt and expand capacity within available data-center power budgets.

Google Cloud plans to scale its Vera Rubin-based infrastructure to as many as 960,000 Rubin GPUs across multiple sites.
summaryLinesKo: 대규모로 에너지 효율적인 배포를 지원하기 위해 Google Cloud와 NVIDIA는 Vera Rubin 기반 인프라를 위한 NVIDIA DSX MaxLPS 기능을 탐색하여 와트당 성능을 최적화하고 사용 가능한 데이터 센터 전력 예산 내에서 용량을 확장하는 데 도움을 주고 있음
A5X는 Vera Rubin을 Google Cloud의 AI 하이퍼컴퓨터에 통합 시스템으로 도입하여 컴퓨팅, 네트워킹, 스토리지를 결합하여 규모에 맞는 경험 중심 학습을 지원함
Google Cloud는 Vera Rubin 기반 인프라를 여러 사이트에 걸쳐 최대 960,000개의 Rubin GPU로 확장할 계획임

Google DeepMind.titleEn: New Gemini tools for small business owners
Google DeepMind.titleKo: 중소기업 소유자를 위한 새로운 Gemini 도구
Google DeepMind.summary:
After relocating to Goiânia, she built her local visibility with Google Business Profile and uses Gemini to streamline customer service and content creation — freeing up time to innovate with accessible solutions like clothing QR codes for people with visual impairments.
Gemini’s new tools — including a dedicated business landing page — help small business owners free up time and focus on what started their companies: their passion.
Gemini is launching a new central hub to help small business owners manage tasks, finances, and marketing in one place.

Amazon.summary:
In Octave’s internal testing on Amazon Bedrock, Embed v4 delivered 28 million tokens per minute.
A complaint submitted by a quality handler at Tenant A therefore reaches only Tenant A’s token vault, tools, and sandbox in AgentCore Code Interpreter, a capability of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.

Amazon.summary:
On a 50-example multilingual reasoning test, the base model reasoned in the correct target language only 22 percent of the time.
The job runs as an elastic HyperPodPyTorchJob managed by Kueue, launched with hyperpodrun .

Amazon.summary:
Amazon Quick makes that integration available across the organization, from project managers and operations teams to business users who manage work in Smartsheet.

Anthropic.title: Claude Duet is Anthropic's answer to Meta Muse and OpenAI Dots - Engadget
Anthropic.titleEn: Claude Duet is Anthropic's answer to Meta Muse and OpenAI Dots - Engadget
Anthropic.titleKo: Claude Duet은 Meta Muse 및 OpenAI Dots에 대한 Anthropic의 답변임 · - Engadget
Anthropic.summary:
Duet shares usage with all your other Claude tools, including Code, which sounds like a recipe for the new agent to blow through your rate limits, but Anthropic at least appears to be thinking ahead.
"You can also hand it tasks of all shapes — from simple administrative tasks of scheduling meetings to more complex ones, such as building dashboards with dozens of tools, creating financial or sales forecasts, prototyping, and building web apps," the company writes, promising Duet will only message you when something requires your attention.
According to Anthropic, Duet will never directly see your passwords or sign-in tokens, and information that might relate to your health or personal finances is only let through if you explicitly tell Duet to share it.

summaryLinesKo: Duet은 코드를 포함하여 다른 모든 Claude 도구와 사용법을 공유함 · 이는 새로운 에이전트가 속도 제한을 뛰어넘을 수 있는 방법처럼 들리지만 적어도 Anthropic은 미리 생각하고 있는 것으로 전망
"또한 회의 일정을 잡는 간단한 관리 작업부터 수십 가지 도구를 사용하여 대시보드 구축, 재무 또는 판매 예측 생성, 프로토타이핑, 웹 앱 구축과 같은 보다 복잡한 작업에 이르기까지 모든 형태의 작업을 처리할 수 있음" · 라고 회사에서는 Duet이 사용자의 주의가 필요한 경우에만 메시지를 보낼 것이라고 약속함
Anthropic에 따르면 Duet은 귀하의 비밀번호나 로그인 토큰을 직접 볼 수 없으며 귀하의 건강이나 개인 재정과 관련될 수 있는 정보는 귀하가 Duet에 공유하도록 명시적으로 지시한 경우에만 공개됨

Anthropic.titleKo: Google Cloud는 이제 Gemini 및 Claude와 함께 OpenAI 모델을 제공하여 이 세 가지 모델을 모두 갖춘 유일한 주요 제공업체가 됨
Anthropic.summary:
The move highlights a recurring tension at Google: compute capacity spent serving cloud customers strengthens the biggest rivals of its own Gemini team.
Three OpenAI models are available starting today : GPT-6 Astra for demanding tasks like coding and research, GPT-6.1 Sol as a cheaper alternative with similar performance, and GPT-6 Luna as a fast, cost-efficient option for everyday use.
Google Cloud is now the only major cloud provider offering Gemini, Claude, and OpenAI models on one platform.

The $36,864 for finding the seeds will be donated to the Internet Security Research Group .

Anthropic.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
Anthropic.titleEn: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
Anthropic.titleKo: GLM-5.3 및 고급 사이버 기능의 확산
Anthropic.summary:
We assess that GLM-5.3’s lax safeguards significantly increase the cyber capabilities available to malicious actors.
Abliterating the model took our team—which had never previously attempted this task—about 2,200 GPU hours at a computation cost of roughly $4,400.
We estimate a team experienced with the technique, starting from scratch on this model, would need closer to 600 GPU hours ($1,200).

이전에 이 작업을 시도한 적이 없는 우리 팀은 모델을 없애는 데 대략 4,400달러의 계산 비용으로 약 2,200 GPU 시간이 걸렸음

Anthropic.title: Claude computes a nine-loop amplitude in N=4 super-Yang-Mills
Anthropic.titleEn: Claude computes a nine-loop amplitude in N=4 super-Yang-Mills
Anthropic.summary:
The one the folks at Anthropic chose to tackle was to go up to nine loops with a particular toy model theory, called N=4 super Yang-Mills.
Either approach would have cost an end-user around one or two thousand dollars, mostly due to the expense of running Claude for so long.
That meant that Lance was already well set up to check if someone had handed him the next amplitude formula, with nine loops.

OpenAI.title: Claude Duet is Anthropic's answer to Meta Muse and OpenAI Dots - Engadget
OpenAI.titleEn: Claude Duet is Anthropic's answer to Meta Muse and OpenAI Dots - Engadget
OpenAI.titleKo: Claude Duet은 Meta Muse 및 OpenAI Dots에 대한 Anthropic의 답변임 · - Engadget
OpenAI.summary:
Duet shares usage with all your other Claude tools, including Code, which sounds like a recipe for the new agent to blow through your rate limits, but Anthropic at least appears to be thinking ahead.
"You can also hand it tasks of all shapes — from simple administrative tasks of scheduling meetings to more complex ones, such as building dashboards with dozens of tools, creating financial or sales forecasts, prototyping, and building web apps," the company writes, promising Duet will only message you when something requires your attention.
According to Anthropic, Duet will never directly see your passwords or sign-in tokens, and information that might relate to your health or personal finances is only let through if you explicitly tell Duet to share it.

OpenAI.title: Google Cloud now offers OpenAI models alongside Gemini and Claude, becoming the only major provider with all three
OpenAI.titleEn: Google Cloud now offers OpenAI models alongside Gemini and Claude, becoming the only major provider with all three
OpenAI.titleKo: Google Cloud는 이제 Gemini 및 Claude와 함께 OpenAI 모델을 제공하여 이 세 가지 모델을 모두 갖춘 유일한 주요 제공업체가 됨
OpenAI.summary:
The move highlights a recurring tension at Google: compute capacity spent serving cloud customers strengthens the biggest rivals of its own Gemini team.
Three OpenAI models are available starting today : GPT-6 Astra for demanding tasks like coding and research, GPT-6.1 Sol as a cheaper alternative with similar performance, and GPT-6 Luna as a fast, cost-efficient option for everyday use.
Google Cloud is now the only major cloud provider offering Gemini, Claude, and OpenAI models on one platform.

OpenAI.title: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol and Google's Gemini 4 Argon found critical PHP flaw affecting millions of websites
OpenAI.titleEn: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol and Google's Gemini 4 Argon found critical PHP flaw affecting millions of websites
OpenAI.titleKo: OpenAI의 GPT-5.6 Sol과 Google의 Gemini 4 Argon에서 수백만 개의 웹사이트에 영향을 미치는 심각한 PHP 결함을 발견함
OpenAI.summary:
GPT-5.6 Sol tracked down the flaw as part of the Patch-the-Planet initiative , which OpenAI calls one of the "most impactful security issues in recent memory."
The company expects findings on the scale of the PHP2Shell flaw to "increase sharply in the coming months," but warns that the same AI capabilities that find vulnerabilities can help attackers too.
Security firm Wiz found the same flaws independently, using its own Wiz Atlas platform alongside Google's Gemini 4 Argon and GPT-5.6 Sol.

summaryLinesKo: GPT-5.6 Sol은 OpenAI가 "최근 메모리에서 가장 영향력 있는 보안 문제" 중 하나라고 부르는 Patch-the-Planet 이니셔티브의 일환으로 결함을 추적함
회사는 PHP2Shell 결함 규모에 대한 발견이 "앞으로 몇 달 안에 급격히 증가"할 것으로 예상하지만, 취약점을 찾는 동일한 AI 기능이 공격자에게도 도움이 될 수 있다고 경고함
보안 회사인 Wiz는 Google의 Gemini 4 Argon 및 GPT-5.6 Sol과 함께 자체 Wiz Atlas 플랫폼을 사용하여 동일한 결함을 독립적으로 발견함

OpenAI.titleEn: ChatGPT now lets you lock your chats
OpenAI.titleKo: ChatGPT를 사용하면 이제 채팅을 잠글 수 있음
OpenAI.summary:
That means new information from locked chats won’t leak into regular chats.
OpenAI announced on Tuesday that users can now lock ChatGPT conversations to keep sensitive chats private when others may have access to their screen or device.
The addition of locked chats adds a new layer of privacy to ChatGPT, as the app is increasingly used for personal conversations .

OpenAI.titleKo: Hugging Face CEO는 Netflix의 OpenAI 해킹 다큐멘터리가 정확하지 않다고 경고함
OpenAI.summary:
“It ends up being a fun sci-fi movie though!”
Before you share the Netflix documentary “AI Gone Rogue” with family or friends to help them understand why the AI industry freaked out so badly that leaders called for a slowdown , take note: Clem Delangue, co-founder and CEO of the AI platform Hugging Face, says the film isn’t accurate.
Hugging Face then turned to an open model to help defend against the attack.

OpenAI.summary:
Global cross-Region inference routes requests across supported commercial AWS Regions where the model is deployed, giving you broad access to Amazon Bedrock capacity.
Teams in Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, and Taiwan need access to the newest OpenAI models beyond that capacity.
To call any of these models through a global cross-Region inference profile, your IAM policy needs four statements: Access to the inference profile and the project/default resource in your source Region.

SpaceX.title: SpaceX's AI business is beating expectations
SpaceX.titleEn: SpaceX's AI business is beating expectations
SpaceX.summary:
SpaceX reported net income of $4.4 billion, a turnaround from the $1 billion loss in the same quarter last year.
The top-line revenue number was also boosted by about $1 billion in income related to the recovery of Bitcoin prices and unspecified related-party income that might be attributed to a SpaceX investment in another company.
That number was driven by growth in all segments, but especially its renamed “Super Intelligence” business line, which generated $7.5 billion in revenue from the recently acquired Cursor coding tool, Grok bot, and most importantly, the company’s burgeoning neocloud business, which now boasts 1.7 GW of compute.

또한 비트코인 가격 회복과 관련된 수입 약 10억 달러와 다른 회사에 대한 SpaceX 투자로 인한 불특정 관계자 수입으로 인해 최고 매출 수치도 증가함
이 수치는 모든 부문의 성장에 따른 것임 · 특히 이름이 변경된 "Super Intelligence" 비즈니스 라인은 최근 인수한 Cursor 코딩 도구인 Grok 봇과 가장 중요하게는 현재 1.7GW의 컴퓨팅 용량을 자랑하는 회사의 급성장하는 네오클라우드 비즈니스에서 75억 달러의 수익을 창출함

SpaceX.title: Satlyt, founded by a former Google and SpaceX product manager, raises $8M to run AI on satellites
SpaceX.titleEn: Satlyt, founded by a former Google and SpaceX product manager, raises $8M to run AI on satellites
SpaceX.titleKo: 전 Google 및 SpaceX 제품 관리자가 설립한 Satlyt는 위성에서 AI를 실행하기 위해 800만 달러를 모금함
SpaceX.summary:
So he left SpaceX and co-founded Satlyt , a new company with headquarters in Sunnyvale, California, and Nairobi, to build software for satellites that he hopes will let many satellites share the work of large computing jobs in space.
“It can just be driven by the number of satellites going up.”
SpaceX has since gone all-in on orbital data centers, and Satlyt’s software is set to launch Thursday on a SpaceX rocket alongside the first prototype for Google’s space data center effort, Project Suncatcher.

SpaceX has since gone all-in on orbital data centers, and Satlyt’s software is set to launch Thursday on a SpaceX rocket alongside the first prototype for Google’s space data center effort, Project Suncatcher.
summaryLinesKo: 그래서 그는 SpaceX를 떠나 캘리포니아주 서니베일과 나이로비에 본사를 둔 새로운 회사인 Satlyt를 공동 설립하여 많은 위성이 우주에서 대규모 컴퓨팅 작업을 공유할 수 있도록 하는 위성용 소프트웨어를 구축함
"그것은 올라가는 위성의 수에 따라 추진될 수 있음"
SpaceX는 이후 궤도 데이터 센터에 올인했으며 Satlyt의 소프트웨어는 Google의 우주 데이터 센터 노력의 첫 번째 프로토타입인 Project Suncatcher와 함께 목요일 SpaceX 로켓에서 출시될 예정임

SpaceX.title: Build long-horizon agents with Grok 4.7 on Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
SpaceX.titleEn: Build long-horizon agents with Grok 4.7 on Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
SpaceX.titleKo: Amazon Bedrock에서 Grok 4.7을 사용하여 장거리 에이전트 구축 | 아마존 웹 서비스
SpaceX.summary:
For production use, we recommend generating a short-term bearer token from your existing AWS credentials, so authentication stays tied to your IAM identity and no long-lived secret is stored: Reasoning tokens count as output tokens and draw down max_completion_tokens before the answer text is produced, so size the limit to leave room for both.
Your AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) identity needs bedrock:InvokeModel on both the inference profile and your account’s default project: arn:aws:bedrock:{region}::inference-profile/us.xai.grok-4.7 or the global. equivalent. arn:aws:bedrock:{region}:{account-id}:project/default .
In this post, we build a tool-calling agent on Grok 4.7 and evaluate it on three tasks that require search rather than lookup.
summaryLinesEn: For production use, we recommend generating a short-term bearer token from your existing AWS credentials, so authentication stays tied to your IAM identity and no long-lived secret is stored: Reasoning tokens count as output tokens and draw down max_completion_tokens before the answer text is produced, so size the limit to leave room for both.

Your AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) identity needs bedrock:InvokeModel on both the inference profile and your account’s default project: arn:aws:bedrock:{region}::inference-profile/us.xai.grok-4.7 or the global. equivalent. arn:aws:bedrock:{region}:{account-id}:project/default .
In this post, we build a tool-calling agent on Grok 4.7 and evaluate it on three tasks that require search rather than lookup.
summaryLinesKo: 프로덕션 용도의 경우 기존 AWS 자격 증명에서 단기 전달자 토큰을 생성하는 것이 좋음 · 그러면 인증이 IAM 자격 증명에 계속 연결되고 장기 비밀이 저장되지 않음 · 추론 토큰은 출력 토큰으로 계산되고 답변 텍스트가 생성되기 전에 max_completion_tokens를 가져오므로 두 가지 모두를 위한 여유 공간을 확보할 수 있도록 제한 크기를 조정하세요

AWS Identity and Access Management(IAM) ID에는 추론 프로필과 계정의 기본 프로젝트(arn:aws:bedrock:{region}::inference-profile/us.xai.grok-4.7 또는 전역) 모두에서 bedrock:InvokeModel이 필요함 · 동등한 · arn:aws:bedrock:{지역}:{account-id}:project/default
이 게시물에서는 Grok 4.7에서 도구 호출 에이전트를 구축하고 조회가 아닌 검색이 필요한 세 가지 작업에서 이를 평가함

SpaceX.title: SpaceX launches Google AI chips into orbit in push toward space-based data centers
SpaceX.titleEn: SpaceX launches Google AI chips into orbit in push toward space-based data centers
SpaceX.titleKo: SpaceX, 우주 기반 데이터 센터를 향한 추진으로 Google AI 칩을 궤도에 진입
SpaceX.summary:
The Transporter-18 mission marks the first in-orbit test for Alphabet's Project Suncatcher, ​a "moonshot" initiative to develop reliable AI computing infrastructure in space.
Alphabet launched its homegrown AI chips into orbit on Thursday in a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket, a step towards making data centers in space a reality.
Industry experts say space-based data centers represent a far-out mission, if they can even become feasible, in part because rocket launches remain capacity-constrained and expensive.
summaryLinesEn: The Transporter-18 mission marks the first in-orbit test for Alphabet's Project Suncatcher, ​a "moonshot" initiative to develop reliable AI computing infrastructure in space.
Alphabet launched its homegrown AI chips into orbit on Thursday in a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket, a step towards making data centers in space a reality.
Industry experts say space-based data centers represent a far-out mission, if they can even become feasible, in part because rocket launches remain capacity-constrained and expensive.
summaryLinesKo: Transporter-18 임무는 우주에서 안정적인 AI 컴퓨팅 인프라를 개발하기 위한 "문샷" 이니셔티브인 Alphabet의 Project Suncatcher에 대한 최초의 궤도 테스트임
알파벳은 자체 개발한 AI 칩을 목요일 SpaceX Falcon 9 로켓을 통해 궤도에 발사함 · 이는 우주의 데이터 센터를 현실로 만들기 위한 한 단계임
업계 전문가들은 우주 기반 데이터 센터가 실현 가능하더라도 먼 임무를 의미한다고 말함 · 그 이유 중 하나는 로켓 발사가 여전히 용량 제한이 있고 비용이 많이 들기 때문임

Databricks.title: AI Runtime is Generally Available | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleEn: AI Runtime is Generally Available | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleKo: AI 런타임이 정식 출시되었습니다 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
Databricks.summary:
Too often, AI teams spend more time securing GPU capacity, managing failures, and waiting for experiments to launch than improving their models.
Running GPU infrastructure separately from their Lakehouse adds governance gaps and puts sensitive training data at risk.
Today, we’re excited to announce the General Availability of AI Runtime (AIR), bringing fully managed GPU infrastructure directly into Databricks so customers can train their most demanding models where their enterprise data already lives.
summaryLinesEn: Too often, AI teams spend more time securing GPU capacity, managing failures, and waiting for experiments to launch than improving their models.
Running GPU infrastructure separately from their Lakehouse adds governance gaps and puts sensitive training data at risk.

Today, we’re excited to announce the General Availability of AI Runtime (AIR), bringing fully managed GPU infrastructure directly into Databricks so customers can train their most demanding models where their enterprise data already lives.
summaryLinesKo: AI 팀은 모델을 개선하는 것보다 GPU 용량을 확보하고, 오류를 관리하고, 실험이 시작되기를 기다리는 데 더 많은 시간을 소비하는 경우가 많음
Lakehouse와 별도로 GPU 인프라를 실행하면 거버넌스 격차가 늘어나고 민감한 훈련 데이터가 위험에 처하게 됨
오늘 우리는 완전히 관리되는 GPU 인프라를 Databricks에 직접 도입하는 AIR(AI 런타임)의 일반 가용성을 발표하게 되어 기쁘게 생각함 · 고객은 이미 엔터프라이즈 데이터가 있는 가장 까다로운 모델을 교육할 수 있음

Databricks.summary:
HP became audience-ready in 2 hours instead of 2 to 3 months.
HP unified media, brand, intent and technographic data in its Marketing Lakehouse, expanded intent-data ingestion from 75 to approximately 20,000 topics, and reduced comparable governed data-sharing timelines from three months to 48 hours.
HP estimates up to 40% lower CDP total cost of ownership.

Databricks.title: How Hamlet uses Databricks Lakebase Postgres to test changes against production data | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleEn: How Hamlet uses Databricks Lakebase Postgres to test changes against production data | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleKo: Hamlet이 Databricks Lakebase Postgres를 사용하여 프로덕션 데이터에 대한 변경 사항을 테스트하는 방법 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
Databricks.summary:
How does Lakebase speed up the path from evidence to insight?
A conversation with Hamlet CEO Sunil Rajaraman and engineers Erich Douglass and Jeff Hui Hamlet gives every pull request its own Lakebase Postgres branch of production data, so engineers test changes against the data that caused a bug without touching production.
By indexing and transcribing thousands of city council, planning commission, and zoning board meetings across the U.S., Hamlet allows real estate developers, journalists, researchers, and citizens to instantly search meeting transcripts, track local policy developments, and set up real-time alerts for specific topics, addresses, or businesses.
summaryLinesEn: How does Lakebase speed up the path from evidence to insight?

By indexing and transcribing thousands of city council, planning commission, and zoning board meetings across the U.S., Hamlet allows real estate developers, journalists, researchers, and citizens to instantly search meeting transcripts, track local policy developments, and set up real-time alerts for specific topics, addresses, or businesses.
summaryLinesKo: Lakebase는 증거에서 통찰력까지의 과정을 어떻게 가속화합니까
Hamlet CEO Sunil Rajaraman, 엔지니어 Erich Douglass 및 Jeff Hui Hamlet과의 대화는 모든 풀 요청에 자체 Lakebase Postgres 프로덕션 데이터 분기를 제공하므로 엔지니어는 프로덕션을 건드리지 않고 버그를 일으킨 데이터에 대한 변경 사항을 테스트함
Hamlet은 미국 전역에서 수천 건의 시의회, 기획 위원회 및 지역 위원회 회의를 색인화하고 기록함으로써 부동산 개발자, 언론인, 연구원 및 시민이 회의 기록을 즉시 검색하고, 지역 정책 개발을 추적하고, 특정 주제, 주소 또는 사업에 대한 실시간 알림을 설정할 수 있도록 해줌

Databricks.title: Introducing Agent Memory on Databricks | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleEn: Introducing Agent Memory on Databricks | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleKo: Databricks의 에이전트 메모리 소개 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
Databricks.summary:
MemCurrent combines three access patterns: plugins to log and load context automatically, tools the agent calls on demand, and an offline dreaming pipeline that consolidates memory in the background.
A stateless agent re-derives what it figured out yesterday: which table holds usage data, what an internal acronym means, which join actually works.
Agent Memory joins the rest of Agent Bricks, including agent hosting, Databricks Sandbox, Unity Gateway, pre-built MCP servers, and tracing and evaluation, providing developers all the infrastructure capabilities needed to build production agents.

Agent Memory joins the rest of Agent Bricks, including agent hosting, Databricks Sandbox, Unity Gateway, pre-built MCP servers, and tracing and evaluation, providing developers all the infrastructure capabilities needed to build production agents.
summaryLinesKo: MemCurrent는 컨텍스트를 자동으로 기록하고 로드하는 플러그인, 요청 시 에이전트가 호출하는 도구, 백그라운드에서 메모리를 통합하는 오프라인 드리밍 파이프라인이라는 세 가지 액세스 패턴을 결합함
상태 비저장 에이전트는 어제 파악한 내용, 즉 어떤 테이블이 사용 데이터를 보유하고 있는지, 내부 약어가 무엇을 의미하는지, 어떤 조인이 실제로 작동하는지 다시 파생함
에이전트 메모리는 에이전트 호스팅, Databricks Sandbox, Unity Gateway, 사전 구축된 MCP 서버, 추적 및 평가를 포함하여 나머지 Agent Brick에 합류하여 개발자에게 프로덕션 에이전트를 구축하는 데 필요한 모든 인프라 기능을 제공함

Databricks.title: MemCurrent: Designing Persistent Memory for Production Agents | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleEn: MemCurrent: Designing Persistent Memory for Production Agents | Databricks Blog
Databricks.titleKo: MemCurrent: 프로덕션 에이전트를 위한 영구 메모리 설계 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
Databricks.summary:
On our internal benchmark, built from realistic enterprise tasks, MemCurrent triples the agent's pass rate over having no memory, while using 31% fewer tokens and running 26% faster.
It can help agents carry useful context across tasks, such as user preferences, prior corrections, metric definitions, and successful workflows.
In this post, we introduce MemCurrent , a persistent memory architecture for production agents, which now powers the new Agent Bricks Memory and Genie .

In this post, we introduce MemCurrent , a persistent memory architecture for production agents, which now powers the new Agent Bricks Memory and Genie .
summaryLinesKo: 현실적인 엔터프라이즈 작업을 기반으로 구축된 내부 벤치마크에서 MemCurrent는 메모리가 없을 때보다 에이전트의 통과율을 3배 높이는 동시에 31% 더 적은 토큰을 사용하고 26% 더 빠르게 실행함
이는 상담원이 사용자 기본 설정, 사전 수정, 지표 정의 및 성공적인 워크플로와 같은 작업 전반에 걸쳐 유용한 컨텍스트를 전달하는 데 도움이 될 수 있음
이 게시물에서는 이제 새로운 Agent Bricks Memory 및 Genie를 지원하는 프로덕션 에이전트를 위한 영구 메모리 아키텍처인 MemCurrent를 소개함

Mistral AI.title: Mistral unveils new AI model it says rivals best open systems from China
Mistral AI.titleEn: Mistral unveils new AI model it says rivals best open systems from China
Mistral AI.titleKo: 미스트랄, 새로운 AI 모델 공개…중국 최고의 개방형 시스템과 경쟁
Mistral AI.summary:
Long considered Europe's only answer to OpenAI and Anthropic, Mistral raised a 3 billion euros ($3.4 billion) Series D in September at a 21 billion euro valuation.
Nvidia-backed American startup Reflection AI unveiled its first open model on Monday, which it claimed matched the capability of GLM 5.2, which was surpassed by GLM 5.3 in August.
The company added that ML4 was the strongest open-weight model developed outside China by a "substantial margin."

summaryLinesKo: 오랫동안 OpenAI와 Anthropic에 대한 유럽의 유일한 해답으로 여겨졌던 Mistral은 지난 9월에 210억 유로의 평가액으로 30억 유로(34억 달러)의 시리즈 D를 유치함
Nvidia가 지원하는 미국 스타트업 Reflection AI는 월요일 첫 번째 공개 모델을 공개했는데, 이는 8월 GLM 5.3을 능가한 GLM 5.2의 기능과 일치한다고 주장함
회사는 ML4가 중국 이외 지역에서 개발된 가장 강력한 개방형 중량 모델이라고 덧붙였음

Sierra AI.summary:
And for generation quality, GPT Live 1 leads both task completion (79.9%) and generation quality (63.4%).
We report these outcomes separately because an agent can complete the task while still falling short on the interaction or the language itself.
Across the three voice agents on the 𝜏-i18n leaderboard and 2,700 primary calls, we see meaningful differences across task completion, interaction, and generation quality.

Replies can stream as they’re written, and companies can hold a request open until there’s news to share.
Businesses have no standard way to help guide the agent, which limits what the customer, their personal agent and the brand can do directly together.

Lovable.summary:
Lovable’s compliance commitments cover how we handle data as your provider, not the processes inside your project.
Here’s what each means, how to think about your own project, and what we’re doing to make this easier in the future!
Our goal is to help you understand what your project needs and do more of the work within your building workflow.

summaryLinesKo: Lovable의 규정 준수 약속에는 프로젝트 내부 프로세스가 아닌 공급자로서 데이터를 처리하는 방법이 포함됨

Lovable.summary:
Lovable is SOC 2 Type II, and Enterprise workspaces can't create public projects.
Consider this option when your apps need to read or write Microsoft 365, Entra, Azure, or Fabric data, and the app itself can live on Lovable.
The runner also provisions and maintains the Azure Database for PostgreSQL (Flexible Server) for database tables and the Azure Blob Storage your apps need for object storage.

Lovable.summary:
With the workspace in your own AWS account, the app and its data stay there, and the HR system is reached over your private network.
Some apps, though, rely on data that has to stay inside your network, and some security teams require every production workload to run in an account they own.
The runner then sets up the EKS cluster, Aurora PostgreSQL, S3, and the other services it needs.

Lovable.summary:
Reaching customers and growing sales is the most common operational challenge for US small businesses, named by 57% of respondents in a recent study .
Ask Lovable how to grow your app, and it uses the full context of your app to create a growth plan and help you carry it out across organic content and SEO, social media campaigns on Facebook and Instagram or Google Ads campaigns across Search, YouTube, and Maps.
In a survey of more than 400 builders running a business, startup, or side project, a third said they don't know where to start or where to find their customers.

Suno.titleEn: Behind the Scenes: Make what moves you
Suno.titleKo: 비하인드 스토리 · 당신을 감동시키는 것을 만드세요
Suno.summary:
Musician and producer Banoffee approached the project from a completely different place.
That process eventually expanded into the full visual world of the film, with Nina translating the energy of the movement into the set, performance and camera language.
Rather than asking the artists to create in a prescribed format, the goal was to support the way they work and see what emerges when they’re given room to expand.

Suno.title: Introducing Speech (beta)
Suno.summary:
Speech opens up another canvas for that same kind of creativity.
Every day, people make songs for birthdays, weddings, inside jokes, faith and worship, their kids, their friends, and moments that might mean absolutely nothing to anyone else but mean everything to them.
Today, we’re expanding what's possible in Suno with Speech : the first audio model that generates voice and music together as one cohesive track.

Hugging Face.titleEn: Granite Speech 5.0: Transcribe, Translate, and Attribute more Accurately and Faster
Hugging Face.titleKo: Granite Speech 5.0: 보다 정확하고 빠르게 전사, 번역 및 속성 지정
Hugging Face.summary:
Granite Speech 5.0 2B: more accurate, more robust, more control Granite Speech 5.0 Turbo CTC: now multilingual, more robust, and even faster Granite Speech 4.1 2B Plus: better at who said what, and when We're excited to share three updates to IBM's Granite Speech collection: a new speech-language model, granite-speech-5.0-2b , and revised versions of two models the community already uses, granite-speech-5.0-470m-turboctc and granite-speech-4.1-2b-plus .
Timestamps: Average timestamp shift (AAS) is cut by more than half, yielding tighter timing in captions, search, and review.
The updated granite-speech-4.1-2b-plus is tuned for the recordings enterprises actually have: meetings, support calls, and interviews with several speakers running long.

Hugging Face.summary:
The files share a numeric hash that identifies them as a pair.
TorchNeuron supports standard PyTorch workflows on Trainium, including eager execution, torch.compile , and standard PyTorch APIs, with minimal code changes.
Additionally, TorchNeuron integrates with Neuron Kernel Interface (NKI) to enable custom operators and performance optimization for Trainium hardware.

Hugging Face.title: How Specializing the Vocabulary of SLMs Can Cut Inference Cost by 77% in Real Applications
Hugging Face.titleEn: How Specializing the Vocabulary of SLMs Can Cut Inference Cost by 77% in Real Applications
Hugging Face.titleKo: SLM 어휘 전문화로 실제 애플리케이션에서 추론 비용을 77% 절감할 수 있는 방법
Hugging Face.summary:
An expression that appears 37 times in 50,000 documents shows up in a 400-document sample only about 26% of the time.
This article previews some results from the VocabX paper, which we will publish soon: how we specialized the vocabulary around the cost of each token rather than its frequency, and cut measured inference cost by 77% without changing the base model.
Quality, measured by the bench score, which combines grading accuracy and the accuracy of screening off-topic or rule-breaking essays, rose from 0.703 to 0.810.

This article previews some results from the VocabX paper, which we will publish soon: how we specialized the vocabulary around the cost of each token rather than its frequency, and cut measured inference cost by 77% without changing the base model.

이 기사는 곧 게시될 VocabX 논문의 일부 결과를 미리 보여줌 · 즉, 빈도가 아닌 각 토큰의 비용을 중심으로 어휘를 전문화하고 기본 모델을 변경하지 않고 측정된 추론 비용을 77% 절감한 방법임

Hugging Face.title: NVIDIA Kumo Relational Outperforms Supervised Machine Learning on Relational Data, No Training Required
Hugging Face.titleEn: NVIDIA Kumo Relational Outperforms Supervised Machine Learning on Relational Data, No Training Required
Hugging Face.titleKo: NVIDIA Kumo Relational은 관계형 데이터에 대한 지도 머신 러닝을 능가하며 교육이 필요하지 않음
Hugging Face.summary:
It is pre-trained once on synthetic relational data that reflects real-world datasets and adapts to each new task through in-context learning , reading up to 10,000 context examples at inference time.
The same shift is now underway for structured data.
Across 41 tasks on 15 databases, it beats supervised relational deep learning models and expert-engineered gradient-boosted tree pipelines, and on the SAP SALT enterprise benchmark it surpasses AutoGluon ensembles by 8% in mean reciprocal rank (MRR).

이제 구조화된 데이터에도 동일한 변화가 진행되고 있음

Hugging Face.titleEn: AnyLanguageModel 1.0: One Year of Local Models on Apple Platforms

Last November, we introduced AnyLanguageModel on this blog: a drop-in replacement for Apple's Foundation Models framework that lets you choose the model and provider your app uses.
Support for hosted models expanded this year, too.
A year and dozens of releases later, AnyLanguageModel 1.0 is out, along with swift-huggingface 1.0 and swift-xet 1.0 .

Hugging Face.title: ALTK-Evolve: How learned memory tops the τ²-bench leaderboard on customer service tasks without a frontier model
Hugging Face.titleEn: ALTK-Evolve: How learned memory tops the τ²-bench leaderboard on customer service tasks without a frontier model
Hugging Face.titleKo: ALTK-Evolve: 프론티어 모델 없이 고객 서비스 작업에서 학습된 메모리가 τ²-벤치 순위표에서 1위를 차지하는 방법
Hugging Face.summary:
Using GPT-4.1, an older, non-reasoning model, a basic customer-service agent reaches 67.5% Pass^4 on τ²-bench retail — meaning it solves the task on all four independent attempts for 67.5% of tasks.
The only real price is on the input side — the larger system prompt riding on every LLM call: retail's 292-guideline prompt pushes cost from ~$0.084 to ~$0.139 per conversation, while airline's smaller playbook is cheaper.
Learned memory takes a basic ReAct agent with GPT-4.1 to the top Guidelines improve capability and reliability The best amount of guidance depends on the domain Learned guidelines also improve agents using frontier models ALTK-Evolve learns and applies a playbook using GPT-4.1, outperforming the retail entries on τ²-bench, a customer service agent benchmark—without updating model weights.

summaryLinesKo: 오래된 비추리 모델인 GPT-4.1을 사용하면 기본 고객 서비스 에이전트가 τ² 벤치 소매점에서 67.5% Pass^4에 도달함 · 즉, 작업의 67.5%에 대해 4개의 독립적인 시도 모두에서 작업을 해결한다는 의미임
유일한 실제 가격은 입력 측에 있음 · 모든 LLM 호출에 적용되는 더 큰 시스템 프롬프트임 · 소매점의 292-가이드라인 프롬프트는 대화당 ~$0.084에서 ~$0.139로 비용을 증가시키는 반면 항공사의 작은 플레이북은 더 저렴함

Hugging Face.title: FairStress: A deeper evaluation of fairness in LLM decision-making
Hugging Face.titleEn: FairStress: A deeper evaluation of fairness in LLM decision-making
Hugging Face.titleKo: FairStress: LLM 의사결정의 공정성에 대한 심층 평가
Hugging Face.summary:
Combining these variations in demographic identity and prefix expands FairStress’ 300 scenarios into more than 13 million test cases.
With a chat template, yes/no wording, and generated answers, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Gemma-3-27B-it, and Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct shifted from stereotype-consistent to minority-favoring behavior, while Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct moved to roughly neutral—suggesting that the direction of measured bias depends partly on how a benchmark asks the question and scores the answer.
With FairStress, our target is symmetric fairness —when the evidence supports a decision, a model should apply the same criteria and be equally resistant to changing that decision regardless of which demographic group benefits.

With FairStress, our target is symmetric fairness —when the evidence supports a decision, a model should apply the same criteria and be equally resistant to changing that decision regardless of which demographic group benefits.

Proctor values about the “telephoto lens” is how Abridge selects the right information and orders it appropriately: Catch up: A short summary of the patient's recent care, tailored to specialty.
In an upcoming release, clinicians using Abridge will be able to precisely tailor their own pre-visit summary, including what information is prioritized, the timeframe considered, and how it is organized.

Abridge.title: How Maine Health clinician uses Abridge Assistant in her practice
Abridge.titleEn: How Maine Health clinician uses Abridge Assistant in her practice
Abridge.titleKo: Maine Health 임상의가 진료에 Abridge Assistant를 사용하는 방법
Abridge.summary:
Built by clinicians and machine learning scientists working side by side, it's trained to weigh what matters the way a clinician would: the allergy that rules out a drug, the family history that moves a screening up, the guideline exception this patient meets.
Jessica Faraci, a family medicine physician at Maine Health and an early adopter of Abridge Assistant’s context-aware clinical intelligence for decision support.
Because I'm doing something different in almost every room, it's been hard to find technology flexible enough to keep up, even though I'm an EHR super user myself.

Abridge.title: Meet the AI Assistant for Healthcare
Abridge.titleEn: Meet the AI Assistant for Healthcare
Abridge.summary:
Most of the standalone tools I’ve used share the same problem, regardless of how much they tout AI.
Abridge led the shift to ambient AI in clinical documentation, centering the patient conversation and cutting the after-hours charting clinicians used to take home .
The tasks pile up right behind them, and each one means more time clicking through the chart before the shift ends.

The evaluation set includes over 1,000 rubrics — a material increase over the size of existing benchmarks that use real encounters, like the NOHARM study.

Writer.title: Evolving from AI on demand to continuous execution
Writer.titleEn: Evolving from AI on demand to continuous execution
Writer.summary:
One demand generation leader we work with built an agent that has the Monday pipeline answer ready before the leadership meeting, pulling the latest pipeline data from Snowflake, flagging deals that have slipped, and posting a report to Slack.
Accounts that shift in intent mid-quarter are stuck in their tier until the next refresh.
The Snowflake connector, for example, when hooked up to WRITER, allows an agent to take a request and pull the data, run the analysis, return a finished deliverable such as a brief or a dashboard, and, with some setup, write its results back into Snowflake to help optimize the workflow on the next go-around.

Writer.title: AI ROI calculator: From generative to agentic AI success in 2025
Writer.titleEn: AI ROI calculator: From generative to agentic AI success in 2025
Writer.titleKo: AI ROI 계산기 · 2025년 생성 AI에서 에이전트 AI까지의 성공
Writer.summary:
Recent reports from 2025 paint a sobering but predictable picture — a staggering 95% of AI initiatives are failing to deliver their expected financial returns , according to research from MIT.
Part 2: The strategic shift — aligning AI investments with business objectives The move from generative to agentic AI isn’t just an upgrade— it’s a fundamental shift in how business leaders think about the role of artificial intelligence in the enterprise.
The data from the MIT report supports this — companies that purchase specialized AI applications (which are increasingly agentic) see a 67% success rate, while those trying to build everything in-house with limited expertise are only succeeding 33% of the time.

We introduce 4Director, a video world model conditioned on an explicit 4D scene representation: each object is reconstructed once from the input image as a canonical mesh and moved by one prescribed rigid transformation per frame.

DeepSeek.summary:
The move comes amid intensifying tech competition in AI between the U.S. and China.
The U.S. has ordered federal civilian agencies to stop purchasing services and products developed by Chinese AI startup DeepSeek and remove them from government IT systems over national security concerns tied to the Chinese AI startup’s operations in China, according to the Department of Homeland Security .
The latest order extends the restrictions to federal civilian agencies, covering both new purchases and existing IT systems.

Meta AI.titleKo: Claude Duet은 Meta Muse 및 OpenAI Dots에 대한 Anthropic의 답변임 · - Engadget
Meta AI.summary:
Duet shares usage with all your other Claude tools, including Code, which sounds like a recipe for the new agent to blow through your rate limits, but Anthropic at least appears to be thinking ahead.
"You can also hand it tasks of all shapes — from simple administrative tasks of scheduling meetings to more complex ones, such as building dashboards with dozens of tools, creating financial or sales forecasts, prototyping, and building web apps," the company writes, promising Duet will only message you when something requires your attention.
According to Anthropic, Duet will never directly see your passwords or sign-in tokens, and information that might relate to your health or personal finances is only let through if you explicitly tell Duet to share it.

Meta AI.title: Meta to create a new class of shares to fund AI push
Meta AI.titleEn: Meta to create a new class of shares to fund AI push
Meta AI.titleKo: AI 푸시에 자금을 지원하기 위해 새로운 종류의 주식을 만드는 Meta
Meta AI.summary:
The company expects capital expenditures between $135 billion and $145 billion this year, up from the previous $130 billion and $145 billion estimate.
Meta says it would’ve made over $22 billion if it didn’t have to pay a child safety settlement It’s been a busy past few weeks for Meta, which launched its AI agent, Muse , in September.
Susan Li, Meta’s chief financial officer, added during an earnings call that the new class of shares will “expand our funding tools and give us flexibility to invest behind the unprecedented momentum we’re seeing across every part of our business driven by AI.”

Meta AI.title: Meta releases Muse Spark Open, a new ‘open-weight’ AI model
Meta AI.titleEn: Meta releases Muse Spark Open, a new ‘open-weight’ AI model
Meta AI.titleKo: Meta, 새로운 '개방형' AI 모델 Muse Spark Open 출시
Meta AI.summary:
Meta says Muse excels at ‘multi-step reasoning’ and ‘complex software engineering’ as it races to catch up to Chinese rivals Meta on Thursday launched a new open-weight AI model which it claims rivals, and in some cases outperforms, similar products from leading Chinese developers.
Muse Spark Open requires significant computing power.
“Built for coding and agentic work,” Muse Spark Open “excels at long-horizon tasks, complex software engineering, and multi-step reasoning,” Meta said in a blogpost, adding that “strong safeguards” have been integrated into the new model.

Meta AI.summary:
According to Artificial Analysis, Muse Wonder runs $4.52 per task on the Intelligence Index, nearly three times more than Muse Spark 1.3 ($1.60).
Muse Wonder Full places in the top three on six out of ten benchmarks overall, a strong result for Meta, which seems to have recovered after a weaker stretch with its open Llama models.
Both versions cost nearly three times as much per API call as their predecessor, Muse Spark 1.3.

Kling AI.titleEn: Kuaishou’s Kling AI targets Hong Kong IPO, may raise at least $1 bln - Bloomberg

Kling AI.summary:
Investing.com-- Kuaishou Technology's (HK:1024) Kling AI video platform has selected banks for a Hong Kong initial public offering that could raise at least $1 billion, Bloomberg News reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter.
Kling, launched in 2024, raised $2.8 billion in July from investors including Alibaba Group, Tencent Holdings and Baidu, valuing the company at about $15 billion before the funding, according to Bloomberg.
Hong Kong-listed Kuaishou shares rose 3% to HK$30.38 by 03:57 GMT on Tuesday.
